Šī politika apraksta, kā {legal} (Smaidu:
This policy describes how {legal} (Smaidu Darbnīca, {address}, {city}) processes the personal data you submit in the website forms.

## What data we process
- First name, last name, position and company name
- Phone number and email address
- Information about the event: date, place, number of participants and your comments

## For what purpose
We use the data only to respond to your request, prepare an offer, conclude a contract and organise the event. We do not use the data for advertising without your separate consent and do not pass it on to third parties, except for service providers that run the website and database.

## Legal basis
Data is processed on the basis of your consent and of steps taken before concluding a contract (GDPR Article 6(1)(a) and (b)).

## How long we keep the data
We keep booking data for no longer than 3 years after the last contact, or as long as required by law for accounting documents.

## Your rights
You have the right to request access to your data, its correction or deletion, and to withdraw your consent. Write to us at **{email}**. If you believe your rights have been violated, you can contact the Data State Inspectorate.

## Cookies
The website uses only technically necessary cookies. The map on the contact page is loaded from Google Maps, which may use its own cookies.
